title: System Configuration Standards
description: Configuration standards are developed, implemented, and maintained for system components consistent with industry-accepted hardening standards.

title: Bespoke and Custom Software Security
description: Bespoke and custom software are developed securely, with software development processes and techniques defined and understood.

title: Security Vulnerabilities in Bespoke Software
description: Software development personnel working on bespoke and custom software are trained at least once every 12 months on software security.

title: Code Review Before Release
description: Bespoke and custom software is reviewed prior to being released into production to identify and correct potential coding vulnerabilities.

title: Prevention of Common Software Attacks
description: Software engineering techniques or other methods are defined and in use to prevent or mitigate common software attacks and related vulnerabilities.

title: Security Vulnerability Identification
description: Security vulnerabilities are identified and managed through an established process that includes using reputable outside sources for vulnerability information.

title: Inventory of Bespoke and Custom Software
description: An inventory of bespoke and custom software, and third-party software components incorporated into bespoke and custom software is maintained.

title: Patching of Identified Vulnerabilities
description: All system components are protected from known vulnerabilities by installing applicable security patches/updates.

title: Change Control Processes
description: Changes to all system components in the production environment are made according to established procedures.

title: Significant Changes Documentation
description: Upon completion of a significant change, all relevant PCI DSS requirements are confirmed to be in place on all new or changed systems and networks.

title: User Authentication for System Access
description: All user access to system components for users and administrators is authenticated via at least one authentication factor.

title: Interactive Use of System and Application Accounts
description: If accounts used by systems or applications can be used for interactive login, they are managed by exception.

title: Internal Vulnerability Scans
description: Internal vulnerability scans are performed at least once every three months and after any significant change.

title: External Vulnerability Scans
description: External vulnerability scans are performed at least once every three months and after any significant change.
